about: v2 (owner OK on v1 as is, 2026-11-11, + music): v1's picture unchanged, with the game's own MusicAPI track "Dusk over the water (take A)" (audio/music/dusk_water_a.m4a, audio/sources.json) from 48.68 s: its phrase at 67.38 s lands on the dissolve to night (output 18.7 s). The music fades in over 0.5 s, sits under everything (-24 LUFS stem), ducks 6 dB under the hook's burst and the show's sound, and fades out under the end card to the last frame. Master -14 LUFS, -1 dBTP, AAC 256 kb/s. An ambience-only delivery (v1's mix) beside it. Deliveries: 1920x1080 at 12 Mb/s and a 1280x720 phone preview.
